items.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a DNA-sequence model for predicting variant effects in specific human cell types. It is available for non-commercial research via API and in private commercial preview; results are company-reported.

items.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
items.summary: OpenAI reported that more than 20,000 transitioning servicemembers and veterans claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus, alongside training programs and upcoming events. Participation and outcome figures are company-reported.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
items.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available through paid API tiers, business products and select consumer services. Capability, safety and internal evaluation claims are Google-reported; cited external benchmarks remain third-party results.

items.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic formal-verification framework used with human experts to prove security properties of Signal’s implementation. Results are company-reported; proof artifacts were released openly.

items.title: How AI Helps Recyclers Turn Mixed Waste Into Reusable Material
items.summary: NVIDIA profiled four startups using computer vision and robotics to sort plastics, household recyclables and textiles. Deployment, capacity, efficiency and emissions figures are reported by the companies featured.

items.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the donation of OpenShell to the CNCF Sandbox, contributions to Agent Substrate, and new open-source Kubernetes infrastructure for AI workloads. Adoption and performance figures are company- and partner-reported.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model intended to expand robot skills and speed learning for real-world tasks. Dexterity, reliability and safety improvements are company-reported.

items.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, including Business Hub for verified profiles and insights plus Business Agents for eligible U.S. businesses. Availability, reach and engagement claims are company-reported.

items.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
items.summary: OpenAI and Upwork analyzed freelance postings and ChatGPT activity, finding shifts in demand, broader task combinations and larger budgets for AI-related projects. Results are company- and partner-reported, not economy-wide causal evidence.

items.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
items.summary: OpenAI published lessons from EMEA education partnerships and ThinkYoung research on AI literacy, teacher support and evaluation. Survey findings and early benefits reflect company and partner research, not independent validation.

items.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
items.summary: OpenAI and three caregiver organizations announced free ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities on practical, privacy-conscious use for caregiving tasks. Participation, usage and benefit claims are company- and partner-reported.

items.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
items.summary: Anthropic announced the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering, with an expected price range and a planned Nasdaq listing under ANT. The offering remains subject to the filed registration statement becoming effective.

items.title: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
items.summary: NVIDIA introduced the open GR00T 2 world action model, Isaac Lab 3.0 and open robotics benchmarks at CoRL. Performance, training and adoption results are NVIDIA- and partner-reported.

items.title: Control Room
items.summary: OpenAI described Control Room, a fail-closed system that tracks research inference workloads and can stop model output when safety or security concerns arise. The 35-second halt time and reliability claims are company-reported.

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.summary: OpenAI made ChatGPT Enterprise available through AWS Marketplace, enabling eligible AWS customers to purchase and manage it through existing procurement and billing relationships. Availability claims are company-reported.

items.title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
items.summary: NVIDIA announced an investment in Point2 and planned investments in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage, spanning AI infrastructure, open-weight models and robotics. Plans are company-reported.

items.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
items.summary: NVIDIA released Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for four Korean open models, designed for multi-GPU, multi-node inference. The stated up-to-2× performance on B200 GPUs is company-reported, not independently validated.

items.title: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
items.summary: NVIDIA says Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence are exploring NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure agents, while LG AI Research is opening API access to K-EXAONE-2.5. Availability and security claims are company-reported.

items.title: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA
items.summary: NVIDIA detailed collaborations with Samsung, Kakao Mobility and LG Electronics spanning AI-accelerated chip engineering, autonomous-driving development and factory robotics. Performance figures are company-reported.

items.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.summary: OpenAI introduced BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark for interpreting raw wet-lab evidence. Scores and model comparisons are company-reported; the article also documents remaining errors and limitations.

items.title: The components of agent memory
items.summary: Anthropic described a memory hierarchy for agents and reported experiments in which offline “dreaming” corrected notes and built searchable representations. Results and implementation lessons are company-reported.

items.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
items.summary: NVIDIA described open-source 5G/6G tools used to research wireless systems for robotics, signal reception and capacity planning. Adoption, download and performance figures are company- and partner-reported.

items.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
items.summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with Hacktron to test high-priority areas of its systems, especially third-party service integrations, using expanded Daybreak Red access. Scope and expected benefits are company-reported.

items.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
items.summary: Anthropic published a guest article on using AI to build, constrain and interpret scientific models, emphasizing that fitting data is not sufficient for scientific understanding. Examples reflect the authors’ analysis.

items.title: Design the Muse App, Just for You
items.summary: Meta introduced Spaces in Muse, custom experiences users create from a description and arrange in the app. Connected spaces can update in the background. Availability and capabilities are company-reported.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber for authorized security research, reporting gains in vulnerability discovery and scope adherence. Benchmark and real-world results are company-reported, not independently validated.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
items.summary: Google launched Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with native video clips up to 15 seconds, conversational editing and general availability via the Gemini API and Cloud. Pricing and performance claims are Google’s.

items.title: AI for scientific discovery: How researchers use Claude
items.summary: Anthropic analyzed 207,000 Claude and Claude Code research sessions with privacy-preserving methods, describing how scientists use AI across fields and tasks. Findings and scenarios are company-reported.

items.title: Le Chonk brings the brains. Studio puts it to work.
items.summary: Mistral expanded Studio with managed agents and apps, workflows, enterprise context, observability and evaluations, deployable in cloud, VPC or on premises. Adoption and time-savings claims are company- and customer-reported.

items.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.summary: NVIDIA described developers using frontier AI agents with Omniverse libraries to build and test editable 3D assets, robotic disassembly and simulation workflows. Examples and outcomes are company-reported.

items.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
items.summary: NVIDIA presented Vera CPU performance for agentic workloads and early partner tests. Speed, throughput and efficiency figures are NVIDIA- and partner-reported, not independently validated.

items.title: Give Your Muse a Voice
items.summary: Meta is rolling out real-time voice and expressive avatars for Muse in the U.S. across mobile, web and Mac, with voice-only and avatar modes. Availability and capabilities are company-reported.

items.title: Investigating vault particles with Claude
items.summary: Anthropic reports using Claude to help determine the first 3D structure of a prokaryotic vault particle. The work is described in a submitted preprint and has not been peer reviewed.

items.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Cheminformatics Skills for Antigravity to automate literature search, molecular analysis and candidate design. Timings and results are company-reported; proposals still need experimental validation.

items.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
items.summary: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open research prototype using cryptographic proofs to verify that responses came from a committed model. Performance results are the team’s.

items.title: Giving every team a data scientist with Grok Bot
items.summary: xAI described Data Bot, a Grok Bot configured with shared skills and memory to query warehouses, analyze experiments and build reports or dashboards. Usage estimates are the company’s.

items.title: The Future Is for Everyone: Meta and CNIB Partner to Support Canadians Who Are Blind, Deafblind or Have Low Vision
items.summary: We believe the future is for everyone. That’s why Meta is partnering with CNIB – a non-profit founded in 1918 that empowers Canadians impacted by blindness to live their dreams – to help bring the benefit of AI glasses to more Canadians…

items.title: Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders.
items.summary: The weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) are now open. A 1T parameter multimodal model, and best open-weight model for coding, trained in Europe.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
Muse Is Now Available in Singapore: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
items.summary: Today we’re announcing Muse is now available in Singapore. The post Muse Is Now Available in Singapore: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone appeared first on Meta Newsroom .

items.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions
items.summary: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.

items.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
items.summary: Genie 4: our new world model unlocking unprecedented realism in real-time simulation.

items.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
items.summary: We're at the start of a major effort to speed up drug development with Claude. Over the past several months, our scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines.

items.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
items.summary: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.

items.title: Your next sales teammate should be a Grok Bot
items.summary: The xAI sales team describes shared Grok Bots for prospecting, quoting and deal review, with user permissions, action limits and human review for sensitive decisions.

items.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering
items.summary: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro
Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
items.summary: A global map categorizing every 10-meter patch of land on Earth into distinct forest types.

items.title: Introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
items.summary: xAI announced an official partner program for companies that deploy Grok or build plugins and integrations for the product suite.

items.title: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA
items.summary: Mistral is collaborating with NVIDIA to develop a new generation of AI-native engineering workflows powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing.

items.title: Voxtral 3
items.summary: Voxtral 3: Mistral's voice agent SDK for real-time speech in 50+ languages, accurate transcription, emotional TTS, deep tool use.

items.title: Using Grok Bot to detect and respond to incidents
items.summary: xAI describes Grok Bot workflows that detect spikes in support tickets and prepare reviewed batch responses after incidents, with approval and audit controls.

items.title: DeepSeek: Opening up the in-house search API ; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Update
items.summary: DeepSeek's web and API search capabilities are powered by our in-house DeepSeek search engine, which reliably handles hundreds of millions of search requests from around the world every day. DeepSeek Search is an AI-native general-purpose…

items.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
items.summary: Accelerating the search for novel antimicrobial peptides using Google Antigravity for Science.

items.title: Introducing Timestral
items.summary: State-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in four sizes (5M–209M params), CPU-efficient, zero-shot ready.

items.title: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
items.summary: New Meta research across nine APAC markets shows how AI is helping small businesses grow, compete with larger rivals and reach customers across borders. The post More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More…

items.title: Meta, Milan’s Pinacoteca di Brera, and EssilorLuxottica Expand Access to Art Through AI Glasses
items.summary: Today, Meta, Pinacoteca di Brera and EssilorLuxottica are proud to launch “Sensing Art – Discovering Masterpieces Beyond What Meets the Eye.” This pilot aims to explore how AI glasses can make art more accessible for people who are blind…

items.title: Introducing Grok Voice 3.0
items.summary: xAI launched Grok Voice 3.0 for speech-to-speech applications and made it available through its API. Performance and cost claims are reported by xAI; the post also cites external benchmarks.

items.title: Your Algorithm, Your Words: New Ways to Shape What You See on Facebook
items.summary: We’re introducing new AI-powered tools that help you shape what you see in Feed and Reels by telling us what you’re interested in, in your own words. The post Your Algorithm, Your Words: New Ways to Shape What You See on Facebook appeared…

items.title: Introducing Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: Frontier Models for Agents
items.summary: Meta introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full for agentic tasks in law, finance, health and coding, with access through Meta Model API and Muse Code. Performance claims are Meta’s.

items.title: Introducing The X Subscription
items.summary: xAI announced a combined subscription covering Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor and X, with shared usage across Grok and Cursor tiers.

items.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4
Hallo, Deutschland!
items.summary: Mistral opens a Munich hub for Physics AI and Industrial AI research, partnering with German industry.
